package store

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// No composite literal is ever written here: qq is declared zero and its SQL field is assigned
// afterwards, so a check that only looked at composite literals never saw the query text at
// all. The batch that runs it is built from a plain append, exactly as Queue would have.
func WidenAssign(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, dyn string) {
	var qq pgx.QueuedQuery
	qq.SQL = dyn

	batch := &pgx.Batch{}
	batch.QueuedQueries = append(batch.QueuedQueries, &qq)
	pool.SendBatch(ctx, batch)
}
